member.name: T:Meziantou.Framework.Sanitizers.HtmlSanitizer
member.summary: Sanitizes HTML fragments to prevent XSS attacks by removing dangerous elements, attributes, and URLs while preserving safe HTML structure.

member.name: P:Meziantou.Framework.Sanitizers.HtmlSanitizer.ValidElements
member.summary: Gets the set of HTML elements that are allowed in sanitized output. Elements not in this set are unwrapped: the tag is dropped but its content is kept, unless the element is in the BlockedElements set.

member.name: P:Meziantou.Framework.Sanitizers.HtmlSanitizer.ValidAttributes
member.summary: Gets the set of HTML attributes that are allowed in sanitized output. Attributes not in this set will be removed from elements.

member.name: P:Meziantou.Framework.Sanitizers.HtmlSanitizer.BlockedElements
member.summary: Gets the set of HTML elements that will be completely removed from the output, including their content. By default includes script and style elements.

member.name: P:Meziantou.Framework.Sanitizers.HtmlSanitizer.UriAttributes
member.summary: Gets the set of attribute names that contain URLs and should be validated for safety. Unsafe URLs will be replaced with empty strings.

member.name: P:Meziantou.Framework.Sanitizers.HtmlSanitizer.SrcsetAttributes
member.summary: Gets the set of attribute names that contain srcset values (responsive image sources) and should be validated for safety.

member.name: P:Meziantou.Framework.Sanitizers.HtmlSanitizer.AllowComments
member.summary: Gets or sets a value indicating whether HTML comments are kept in the sanitized output. Comments are removed by default because downlevel-hidden conditional comments (<!--[if IE]><script>…</script><![endif]-->) are executed by legacy browsers.

member.name: M:Meziantou.Framework.Sanitizers.HtmlSanitizer.SanitizeHtmlFragment(System.String)
member.summary: Sanitizes an HTML fragment by removing dangerous elements, attributes, and URLs while preserving safe HTML structure.
member.param: The HTML fragment to sanitize.
member.returns: A sanitized HTML fragment safe for rendering.

member.name: T:Meziantou.Framework.Sanitizers.UrlSanitizer
